formation_document_name: Articles of Organization for a Domestic Limited Liability Company (Form 610)
filing_fee_notes: Base filing fee; expedited service costs extra.
registered_agent_rules: Appoint an Ohio resident or eligible entity with an Ohio address; the agent must accept the appointment. Private mailbox services are prohibited. A P.O. box alone is prohibited; the form permits a P.O. box combined with a rural route number.
expedite_options: Additional 100 for two business days, 200 for one business day, or 300 for four-hour service with in-person delivery by 1 p.m.; later four-hour requests are processed by noon the next business day.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a statutory agent. Ordinary LLCs have no regular Secretary of State annual report.
common_mistake: Do not use a private mailbox service as the statutory agent's address.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Report name, deadline and filing URL are null because ordinary LLCs are outside the SOS's regular reporting categories. Name-search URL, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
